name: Mizushima Aoi
source:
A short, cute, and delicate-looking young man. To further his job as a teacher, he joined the faculty of Misakura Girl's Academy--

He quickly becomes his students' plaything, while also dealing with his reunion with his childhood friends Yuuka and Aika.
